title: 14.30. Savitakkadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Savitakkaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasavitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Avitakkaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naavitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… purejāte āsevane cha …pe… avigate nava.
Savicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Avicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… purejāte āsevane cha …pe… avigate nava.
